stories.title: Critical Java 17 RCE Vulnerability Puts Servers at Risk as Oracle Releases 11 Security Fixes
stories.description: A remote code execution (RCE) vulnerability in Java 17 has prompted warnings for server admins, especially as Oracle released 11 new Java SE security updates on the same day.

stories.title: Market Research Giant Ipsos Investigating Breach of Internal System
stories.description: The company made the incident public on Monday, November 16, five days after filing a complaint with authorities.

stories.title: Hackers Abuse Microsoft SharePoint and GitHub to Hide GraphDoor Backdoor Attacks on Government Networks
stories.description: Hackers are hiding a backdoor named GraphDoor inside normal Microsoft and Ably traffic. The goal is to spy on government networks in Asia and Africa.

stories.title: Hackers Exploit Unpatched Microsoft Exchange Servers to Deploy Custom RATs Across Southeast Asia
stories.description: Hackers exploit vulnerable Exchange and web servers to deploy custom RATs and spy on Southeast Asian government networks.

stories.title: Fandango Warns Ticket Buyers of Payment Card Data Exposure
stories.description: Card numbers, CVVs, expiration dates, and email addresses used at Fandango’s ticketing checkout over four days in October may have been exposed.

stories.title: Pretxt Emerges Stealth With $5M Seed and an AI Supervision Tool
stories.description: Pretxt provides technology to prevent AI agents escaping their guardrails and causing unintended harm.

stories.title: Hackers Use Fake Shipment ZIP Files and DLL Side-Loading to Deploy PureLogs and PureRAT Malware
stories.description: Hackers use shipment-themed ZIP files and DLL side-loading to deliver PureLogs and PureRAT malware through trusted apps.

stories.title: MSP ScreenConnect Servers Targeted in Month-Long Campaign
stories.description: More than 40 servers received over 688,000 requests exploiting CVE-2026-84869 to execute guest-pushed files.

stories.title: Hackers Found a Way Around GitHub SHA Pinning. This Webinar Explains How to Close the Gap
stories.description: GitHub Actions attackers exploited SHA pinning trust gaps to disguise malicious commits, while new workflow lockfiles leave provenance risks unresolve

stories.title: Researchers Detail iPhone Flaw That Let Apps Record Audio Despite Denied Microphone Permission
stories.description: Apple patched CVE-2026-65339, which let installed apps record audio despite denied microphone permission on iPhones and iPads.

stories.title: New GitDoor and GraphDoor Backdoors Turn GitHub and SharePoint Into Covert C2 Channels
stories.description: Operation ShadowCloud targets governments in Asia and Africa with GitDoor and GraphDoor backdoors using GitHub and SharePoint for C2.

stories.title: Apple Tightens macOS App Permissions to Limit Data Access Amid AI Agent Security Risks
stories.description: Apple introduces granular app and folder permissions in macOS 27.3 beta 2 to improve data access transparency amid AI agent security risks.
